normalized.summary: Chen Shen and Yaneer Bar-Yam, Where do pre-symptomatic and asymptomatic cases come from in China?, New England Complex Systems Institute (April 3, 2020). Download PDF Comment on “ Covid-19: four fifths of cases are asymptomatic, China figures indicate ” Michael Day [1] claims there are 78% asymptomatic cases in China based on the daily report of China National Health Commission on COVID-19 cases.
